name: Righteous Fury grants the 6% melee crit reduction 991293 only while Protection is the Paladin's main talent tree
contract: A Paladin holding Righteous Fury (25780, Reborn 1125780) gets spell 991293 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_MELEE_CRIT_CHANCE -6, absolute daze immunity) only while Protection (TalentTab 383, tab page 1) holds the most talent points of the active spec, as Player::GetMostPointsTalentTree decides it. Without talents the main tree is Holy, so Righteous Fury alone grants nothing. Learning a Protection talent (2185 Divine Strength) grants it, a talent reset removes it, and Retribution (1407 Benediction) outweighing Protection keeps it away until Protection leads again. 991293 follows Righteous Fury through a relog. The attacker carries QA aura 25848 (+10 crit) so the 0 clamp cannot hide the -6.

steps.label: SETUP: the Paladin starts without Divine Strength
SETUP: Righteous Fury is up
Righteous Fury without talents grants no 991293
SETUP: Divine Strength is learned
A Protection talent makes Righteous Fury grant 991293
Protection Righteous Fury lowers the melee crit chance taken by 6 points
Protection Righteous Fury makes the Paladin immune to daze
Dropping Righteous Fury removes 991293
Reborn Righteous Fury grants 991293 to a Protection Paladin
Dropping Reborn Righteous Fury removes 991293
Righteous Fury grants 991293 again
SETUP: Righteous Fury survives the relog
991293 follows Protection Righteous Fury through the relog
SETUP: the reset removed Divine Strength
SETUP: Righteous Fury stays through the talent reset
A talent reset removes 991293
SETUP: two Benediction ranks are learned
Retribution as the main tree grants no 991293
SETUP: one Divine Strength rank is learned
One Protection point under two Retribution points grants no 991293
SETUP: three Divine Strength ranks are learned
Protection leading Retribution makes Righteous Fury grant 991293
